scope: New exploratory conditional paired statistics and explicit per-image tables from nine unchanged stored CSV sources only.

policies.primary: Raw learned outputs only. Blended outputs excluded.
policies.seed_level: Five refiner-training means, matched by seed for learned controls; one shared baseline is repeated only as deterministic paired reference, not as five fitted baselines.
policies.unit_sensitivity: Average all five fitted outputs within each image, then average the two eyes within each CHASE subject. DRIVE/HRF image units; patient independence unverified.
policies.t: Two-sided paired t statistic on difference vector; sample SD, df=n-1, two-sided 95% t interval. Conditional independence/normality assumptions and tiny seed n apply.
policies.wilcoxon: Two-sided exact signed-rank sign-enumeration distribution; zeros dropped (wilcox), average ranks for ties, dynamic programming over doubled integer ranks. No asymptotic fallback.
policies.holm: For each of seed-level and patient/image-level analyses, and separately for t and Wilcoxon: primary family has 9 tests (3 predeclared recipe comparisons x 3 datasets); secondary baseline family has 9 tests (O1/O2/O3 versus baseline x 3 datasets). The two families are separate, not overall18 FWER control.
policies.undefined_t: Zero variance: t/p unavailable; use p=1 as conservative placeholder for correction of the other eight tests; mark unavailable cell. Exact signed-rank p=1 if all differences zero.
policies.existing_intervals: Previously reported unadjusted bootstrap intervals are not recomputed or replaced; new t intervals identify a different uncertainty unit.
policies.no_claim: No new raw-array loading, prediction evaluation, training, confirmatory superiority, equivalence, baseline variability or external-population claim. Outcome inspection predates this completion plan.

public_derivative_note: Machine-specific original_path fields omitted; source CSV bytes, arm mappings, policies and contrasts unchanged.
